svg.title: R84 mean number of independently externally recovered otherwise missing gaze values under 25 and 50 percent source ascertainment
svg.desc: Primary two signed extreme independent predictor anchor and heteroskedastic source. Mean randomly independently recovered missed gaze sample counts per original source: independent curves MAR 174.4375/350.71875, MNAR 189.59375/376.5; repeated participants MAR 317/634.875, MNAR 362.15625/726.71875 for 25 vs 50 percent recovery. Zero recovery supplies no recovered Y and cannot identify the latent outcome-selection coefficient by design. These counts are observed measurements not independent units.
svg.text: R84: validation contributes previously unobserved outcomes
Mean number of otherwise missing gaze coordinate observations randomly recovered per complete synthetic source, n=32 blocks per cell
0% recovery → 0 otherwise-missing outcomes externally ascertained → no fitted δ, not a point estimate of zero.
Counts are gaze time×coordinate×trial samples, NOT independent participant counts. Recovery probability is randomized in the simulator.
No real eye tracker, MNAR identifying instrument or clinical/field validation source is established by this experiment.
